text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAH~~~~?! A GHOOOST~~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is the place, is it not?! Where the 
bright red ghost appeared last night!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... it might've just been a trick of 
the eye~. Though King said she saw it too, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And having seen it, King-san hasn't been 
able to focus on training... How pitiable!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It falls upon me to exorcise it after 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall search high and low!! Chasing it 
to the ends of the earth and beating it to 
a pulp!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To the ends of the earth... W-Wait! I'm 
coming with you, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you go rampaging around, you'll trash 
the dorms for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I heard groaning sounds coming from the 
washroom from time to time! We had ghost 
rumors back home too, so maybe they're 
related?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*groan*... *urgh*... *groan*...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I heard it! This is just what Fine-san 
was speaking of—

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Ah, fell asleep again. Waiting for 
laundry always makes me... Guess I'll head 
back.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The kitchen at night is *dangerouuus*... 
They say a girl with a quiet smile appears 
and gobbles you right up...!?

Hehe... Ufufu... I'm sorry, I'm so 
sorrryyy...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Gah, it's here...!?

text_block_list.name: Drooling Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being here in the middle of 
the night...! I'm sorry midnight snacks 
taste so good...! I'm so sorry for 
tonkotsu ramen... It's the best!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! W-We haven't run into a 
single ghost at all, have weee~!?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Kawakami-chan, you guys are dripping 
in sweat! Have you been sprinting around 
searching this whole time!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... I was thinking maybe this is good 
enough. If we haven't found it after 
searching everywhere, then maybe—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOOOOOO!! Whether it's "here" or "not 
here" doesn't matter anymore!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't here, we need proof that it 
wasn't! If it was here, we need proof and 
an exorcism!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We must settle this incident in black and 
white and create an environment where 
King-san can feel at ease! And 
furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anyone here to ever feel 
scared! I will resolve this no matter 
what, mark my words!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san...! Going that far just for 
us...

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
In that case! We'll help too! It's a 
problem for all of us, so let us share the 
burden!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Can't be helped! I'm the one who 
started this anyway. In for a penny, in 
for a pound—I'll stick with you till the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Now, let us join 
together! One, two—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*flicker—*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~~!? A-A blackout!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on! Over by the wall... what's 
that glowing...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up staying late with work... Just 
as I was rushing back to my room—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*KABLAAM!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Ghost! Halt right there, you fiend!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, forgive me! I am currently in pursuit 
of a ghost! Pardon the intrusion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What just happened? I'm not quite sure, 
but I have a feeling there will be hell to 
pay for that giant hole in the wall later 
on...
